description: Create or update a file. Pass mode: "create" | "update". Binary uploads: call with binary: true to get an upload_url, then PUT bytes, then call with mode: "finalize".

asset_id.description: Existing asset ID to retrieve URL without re-uploading.

content_type.description: MIME type. Defaults to "text/markdown" for content, "image/png" for file_data.

file_id.description: File ID to update (required for update/finalize).

image_data.description: Base64-encoded image. Alternative to image_url when the bytes are already local.

image_url.description: Public URL to download and host permanently.

mode.description: "create" for new files, "update" to edit existing, "finalize" to complete a binary upload.

name.description: File name (required for create, max 200 chars).

section.description: Which section to file under (required for create).

name: file_write
title: Write File
